payload.reason: The evidence indicates that a new set of error categories was designed to improve granularity, reduce annotator workload, and ensure dataset independence, which were limitations of previous tagsets.

claims.text: The new error categories allow for evaluation at different levels of granularity, which was not possible with the previous tagsets.
The new framework is dataset-agnostic, avoiding biases present in classifiers trained on specific datasets, unlike the CoNLL-2014 tagset.
The new error scheme is based on automatically obtained properties of the data, enhancing practicality and transparency in error classification.
